lifecycle_stages.nutrient_guidance: Treat delinted seeds with Trichoderma viride @ 5g/kg or Imidacloprid (seed dressing) for early sucking pest protection.
lifecycle_stages.precautions: Ensure certified hybrid/Bt cotton seed packet with refuge seed component.

lifecycle_stages.stage_name_hi: 2. खेत की गहरी जुताई एवं तैयारी
lifecycle_stages.irrigation_guidance: Pre-sowing irrigation (Paleva) to ensure root zone moisture.
lifecycle_stages.nutrient_guidance: Incorporate FYM @ 10 t/ha + Basal full P, full K, and 20% N.
lifecycle_stages.pest_disease_scouting: Scout for previous season pink bollworm carryover larvae in field debris.
lifecycle_stages.precautions: Deep summer ploughing to expose pupae of bollworms and root-rot fungi.

lifecycle_stages.nutrient_guidance: Basal fertilizer placement in bands 5 cm away from seed line.
lifecycle_stages.precautions: Maintain 90x60 cm or 67.5x60 cm spacing depending on variety and soil type.

lifecycle_stages.irrigation_guidance: No irrigation needed if germination is uniform.
lifecycle_stages.nutrient_guidance: No top-dressing at this early stage.
lifecycle_stages.pest_disease_scouting: Scout for thrips and jassids curling seedling cotyledons.
lifecycle_stages.precautions: Perform gap filling within 10 days of sowing to ensure plant population.

lifecycle_stages.irrigation_guidance: Irrigate at 12-15 day intervals; do not cause waterlogging.
lifecycle_stages.nutrient_guidance: 1st Top-dressing of Nitrogen (Urea) at squaring (40-45 DAS).
lifecycle_stages.pest_disease_scouting: Intense scouting for Whitefly, Jassids, and early Pink Bollworm (PBW) rosetted flowers.
lifecycle_stages.precautions: Install yellow sticky traps @ 10/acre for whitefly monitoring.

lifecycle_stages.irrigation_guidance: Critical moisture stage; water stress causes severe square and flower drop.
lifecycle_stages.nutrient_guidance: 2nd Top-dressing of Nitrogen + Magnesium Sulphate (1%) and 19:19:19 foliar spray.
lifecycle_stages.pest_disease_scouting: Install Pheromone traps (Pectino-lure) @ 5/acre for Pink Bollworm moth monitoring.
lifecycle_stages.precautions: Scout 20 green flowers per acre; if >5% show 'rosetted flower' symptom, trigger IPM.

lifecycle_stages.irrigation_guidance: Ensure regular furrow moisture; avoid standing water on root collars.
lifecycle_stages.nutrient_guidance: Foliar spray of Potassium Nitrate (13:0:45) @ 1.5% and Boron (0.1%) to enhance boll weight.
lifecycle_stages.pest_disease_scouting: Destructive sampling of green bolls: check for Pink Bollworm internal bore entry and boll rot.
lifecycle_stages.precautions: Avoid excess nitrogen late in season which delays boll maturity and attracts sucking pests.

lifecycle_stages.irrigation_guidance: Gradually reduce irrigation frequency; stop prior to peak picking.
lifecycle_stages.pest_disease_scouting: Check for stained or discolored lint caused by red cotton bugs (Dysdercus koenigii).
lifecycle_stages.precautions: Ensure bolls open under dry sunshine to avoid fiber staining.

lifecycle_stages.pest_disease_scouting: Separate PBW damaged/stained locules from clean white seed cotton.
lifecycle_stages.precautions: Pick cotton after dew has evaporated; avoid trash, dried leaves, or polypropylene fiber contamination.

lifecycle_stages.stage_name_hi: 10. कटाई उपरांत प्रबंधन एवं सुरक्षित भंडारण
lifecycle_stages.pest_disease_scouting: Destroy cotton stalks with rotavator/mulcher to break pink bollworm diapausing cycle.
lifecycle_stages.precautions: Store picked seed cotton (Kapas) in clean dry room with <=8% moisture.
